Features memory efficiency breakthroughs and expanded context management for agentic development.

name: Superset
description: An agent-native IDE that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents in parallel, using git worktree isolation to prevent conflicts. Core is multi-agent orchestration engine with code editing as supporting feature. Supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, and other CLI-based coding agents. Features remote workspaces to run agents on other machines, preserving local memory and CPU.
community_quotes: YC P26 batch project with 11k+ GitHub stars
Core is multi-agent orchestration engine, not code editor
Solves multi-agent parallel coding with git worktree isolation
Not an agent, but an OS for running agents
Agents run on remote machines instead of using local memory and CPU

name: Google Antigravity CLI
description: A terminal-based coding agent CLI that allows developers to run and monitor AI coding agents directly from their command line. Features multi-step reasoning, multi-file editing, tool calling, and persistent history. Ranked #2 on Product Hunt May 23, 2026. Designed for SSH sessions and keyboard-focused workflows.
community_quotes: #2 Product of the Day on Product Hunt May 23, 2026
Most lightweight way to invoke, monitor, and interact with Antigravity agents
Designed for SSH sessions and keyboard-focused workflows
